subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 22 updates

question: Should maintainers accept this grouped 22-production-dependency update as one compatibility batch, or split higher-risk runtime/build/CLI packages first?
rationale: The diff is mechanically clean and green, but production dependencies are used across UI routes, Convex, email/image/rendering, CLI prompts, and schema parsing, so accepting that grouped compatibility risk is a maintainer judgment.

options.title: Accept grouped update
options.body: Approve the configured Dependabot group with current CI, CodeQL, secret scan, Playwright, and Vercel preview evidence while owning the grouped compatibility risk.

options.title: Split higher-risk packages
options.body: Ask for separate updates around Convex/TanStack, sharp/resend, and CLI/schema dependencies if isolated rollout and rollback matter more than batching.

recommendation.title: Accept grouped update
recommendation.body: Approve the configured Dependabot group with current CI, CodeQL, secret scan, Playwright, and Vercel preview evidence while owning the grouped compatibility risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest routing signal from dependency-block blame, Dependabot config history, and CODEOWNERS on core backend/CLI/schema surfaces affected by this bump.
